drivers.text: Data Center revenue growth was driven by the ramp of Blackwell Ultra infrastructure; Hyperscale more than doubled YoY and rose 13% sequentially, and AI Clouds, Industrial and Enterprise rose 138% on AI-native, enterprise, sovereign and hyperscaler-via-AI-cloud demand.
Gross margin rose YoY on improved Blackwell Ultra mix and was about flat sequentially.
Operating expenses up 55% YoY, driven by higher compute infrastructure costs and compensation and benefits.

Supply commitments (mainly memory and manufacturing) rose from $119 billion to $279 billion in one quarter to meet multi-year demand; NVIDIA also announced financing platforms with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital, subject to definitive agreements.
